description: Append graded sessions to a Google Sheet. Customer creates a sheet, shares it with the OAuth account, and pastes the spreadsheet_id here (or stores it on the account). Each row: [graded_at, session_id, click_id_value, click_id_type, network, page_url, grade, numeric_score, ad_network_signal_type, crm_pipeline, conversion_value]. Pass since= to incrementally export only new grades.

since.description: ISO-8601 — only export grades after this time

name: dr_export_to_sheet
